quadrants.exerts: Exerts a zone and is pinned by one
quadrants.ignores-mounted: Ignores zones, but Polearm units still pin it

scenarios.caption: A land unit controls the six tiles around it.
scenarios.title: The zone

scenarios.caption: Stepping into the zone is free; stepping from one controlled tile to another is refused.
scenarios.title: Enter freely, then stop

scenarios.caption: Leaving the zone is always legal, so you walk in, out, and back in on the far side.
scenarios.title: Slip around

scenarios.caption: Every route north needs a controlled-to-controlled step, so the line holds.
scenarios.title: Pickets two tiles apart

scenarios.caption: One free tile between the zones is enough: in, out, and through.
scenarios.title: Pickets three tiles apart

scenarios.caption: A Horseman ignores the archer's zone but a Polearm unit still pins it.
scenarios.title: Cavalry vs archer vs spearman

scenarios.caption: Elephants ignore nothing: an archer pins a War Elephant like any infantry.
scenarios.title: Elephant pinned by an archer

scenarios.caption: Elephants also exert no zone: a Spearman walks right round one.
scenarios.title: Elephant pins nothing

scenarios.caption: Across a river the enemy exerts nothing, but you may not cross that river straight into a zone.
scenarios.title: Rivers

scenarios.caption: A city tile is never inside a zone, so a pinned unit can always step home; enemy cities project a zone of their own.
scenarios.title: Cities

scenarios.caption: A ship controls the adjacent water tiles only; the shore beside it stays free.
scenarios.title: Water: ships

scenarios.caption: A ship also pins land units crossing its water under your own ship's control.
scenarios.title: Water: land units afloat

scenarios.caption: You may march through an enemy Worker's tile but never stop on it, so nothing can land there.
scenarios.title: A Worker holds the beach

scenarios.caption: An Ambusher-led archer standing unseen in woods exerts no zone at all.
scenarios.title: Hidden units
Swap refused when both tiles are pinned
Mahout general gives elephants a zone
Mahout on a horse does nothing (elephants only)
Maneuvers lets a ship ignore ship zones
A Scout under the Exploration law is a water unit and keeps its ignore
A Scout without the law is pinned afloat like anyone else
A Worker may end on own-territory water and is pinned by ships
Ignore-ZOC units are exempt from city zones
A hidden mover is not pinned on its hiding tile

texts.help: A land military Unit exerts a Zone of Control (ZOC) over all adjacent land Tiles, and a ship exerts ZOC over all adjacent water Tiles. A Unit may not move directly from one Hostile ZOC into an adjacent Tile that is also under a Hostile ZOC, unless the destination Tile lies on the opposite side of a river from the hostile Unit exerting the ZOC. Hold [X] to see Unit ZOCs.
texts.hint: Hold [X] to highlight Zones of Control.
texts.ignores: Ignores the Zone-of-Control of enemy Units.
texts.spearman: The Spearman is the first Polearm Unit available to your Nation. Polearm Units excel against enemy Mounted Units. Only Polearm Units can exert a ZOC on Mounted Units. Spearmen also have a Pierce attack, striking the unit behind their target for partial damage.
